description: Source code for the Opencart Catalog Model class 'Download' which manages download data, including retrieving download details, listing downloads, counting total downloads, and adding download reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class for handling download-related database operations within the Opencart system.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific download by its ID, considering order status and customer ID.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Lists downloads with pagination, filtered by customer and store, including order details.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Counts total downloads available for the current customer and store, considering order status.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a report entry for a download, recording IP, country, and timestamp.
